about_the_game:
Welcome to the Mechanoid Demo. In a world overrun by hostile machines, survival depends on quick reflexes, perfect timing, and knowing when to upgrade your gear. Mechanoid delivers pure platforming action where every jump matters and every improvement counts. Each movement must be calculated, each shot timed perfectly. One wrong step or delayed reaction can end in disaster. 

Play 4 levels of this high-octane blast fest for yourself!
